description.ja: ジ・オリジンＭＳＤで考察されるＭＳの系譜をＨＧキットで再現！
description.en: The genealogy of MS considered in The Origin MSD is reproduced with HGKit!

description.ja: ザク系ＭＳの進化系統から誕生した “ＹＭＳ－０７Ａ－０ プロトタイプグフ（機動実証機 サンドカラーＶｅｒ．）”が登場！！
description.en: “YMS-07A-0 Prototype Gouf (Mobile Demonstrator Sand Color Ver.)”, born from the evolutionary lineage of Zaku-based MS, is now available! !

description.en: Prototype Gouf (Mobile Demonstrator Sand Color Ver.) is commercialized with the HG series kit.

description.ja: 印象的なカラーリングを成形色で再現し、前腕部および武器を新規造形で再現!
description.en: The impressive coloring is reproduced with molded colors, and the forearms and weapons are reproduced with new molding!

description.ja: ●　旧ＭＳＶ版を彷彿とさせる成形色カラー！
description.en: ● Molding color reminiscent of the old MSV version!

description.ja: ●　店頭発売（別売）の「プロトタイプグフ（戦術実証機）」とは異なる前腕部形状を新規造形で再現！
description.en: ● The shape of the forearm, which is different from the "Prototype Gouf (Tactical Demonstration Machine)" released in-store (sold separately), is reproduced with new modeling!

description.ja: ●　腕部・脚部は、他のグフとは異なり、２色で構成！
description.en: ● The arms and legs are made of two colors, unlike other Goufs!

description.ja: ●　マシンガンは、ディテールも豊かな新規造形で再現！
description.en: ● The machine gun is reproduced with a new model with rich details!

description.ja: ●　オリジナルマーキングが、新規デザインで付属！
description.en: ● Original Marking is included with a new design!

description.ja: 旧ＭＳＶ版にも描かれているシールドのナンバリングも収録。
description.en: Also includes Seal numbering, which is also depicted in the old MSV version.

description.ja: ●　ヒート・ホークは、バトル形態および収納形態（携行用）の２種が付属。
description.en: ● Heat Hawk comes in two types: battle mode and storage mode (portable).

description.ja: 付属武装 ： ＭＳ用マシンガン　／ ヒート・ホーク ／ シールド
description.en: Attached weapons: MS machine gun / Heat Hawk / Seal
